## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (or no behavior change)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] ESM and CJS builds still work (`npm run build`, `npm run attw` when exports change)
- [ ] Docs describe only implemented behavior
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private prompts in the diff or logs
- [ ] Breaking change is labeled `breaking-change` and called out below (or N/A)
